editorial.description_en: Paper in an unlit room: not black, and cool enough to read as a colour rather than as an absence.
editorial.description_ja: 暗い部屋の紙のような、青みのある濃い灰色。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.268, C 0.014, h 264.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 夜 (yoru, night) + 紙 (kami, paper), rendaku to -gami. It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Night Paper" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 夜紙. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — shimo-yo at ΔE00 5.3, soko-zumi at ΔE00 6.6, yaki-sugi at ΔE00 11.7. complementary is empty because at chroma 0.014 the hue is not a reliable enough statement to oppose. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
